macovedj opened PR #14132 from macovedj:winch-trap-on-throw to bytecodealliance:main:

This PR begins the process of adding EH support for Winch. Following the approach outlined in the rfc, this first step compiles try_table as a plain block and compiles throw and throw_ref as uncatchable traps. Follow on PRs will implement full catch/throw behavior.

:speech_balloon: saulecabrera created PR review comment:

<A as ABI>::sizeof(&ty) below has this exact same validation. Instead of panicking, perhaps we could make this method return Result<u8>. This is a larger refactoring than adding this validation here, but consolidates the type validations to a centralized place.

:speech_balloon: saulecabrera created PR review comment:

I think this change is completely orthogonal to this PR? I removed it and nothing seems to break. Maybe we should add it in a different PR?

It seems that without this, compiling an exceptions module, results in a when resolving the gc_compiler?

:speech_balloon: saulecabrera created PR review comment:

Could we encode this rule in the wasmtime_test macro instead of duplicating it?
macovedj updated PR #14132.

:speech_balloon: macovedj created PR review comment:

Makes sense! I actually also caught another redundant check while propagating the error that I was able to get rid of too.
:memo: macovedj submitted PR review.

:speech_balloon: macovedj created PR review comment:

Before I do, I didn't actually have to add the rule to every test. I'm not sure there's a clean way to leave the tests that don't need it. But also ideally this change shouldn't be here very long since I intend to follow up with the rest of the EH implementation soon. If you're comfortable with it, I can go ahead add some logic to just disable all of these tests for the time being.

Not sure it will be clear which PR it actually belongs with, but I'm happy to leave this out for now and went ahead and got rid of the check.
